canonical_target.claim: For every finite nonempty simple graph G regular of positive natural degree k, its real independence number is at most |V| * (-lambda_min) / (k - lambda_min), where lambda_min is the least real adjacency eigenvalue.
canonical_target.scope_boundary: The target is the unweighted finite simple-graph ratio bound with positive natural degree and mathlib's least Hermitian adjacency eigenvalue. Chromatic, equality, weighted, irregular, Laplacian, clique, Lovasz-theta, and strongly regular variants receive no root credit without a checked transport.
